name: Station Bistro & KTV
description: Station is a popular karaoke venue known for its private rooms and extensive song selection, catering to both Western and Eastern tastes. The sound system is praised for its quality, providing an enjoyable singing experience. The venue offers a comfortable atmosphere suitable for groups, with friendly staff and reasonable prices. It is open daily, making it accessible for spontaneous or planned karaoke sessions. Food and drinks are available, and parking is convenient nearby. Overall, Station stands out as a welcoming spot for friends and families to enjoy karaoke in a clean, well-maintained environment with a variety of song options and good amenities.
